Safety is a priority built into this truck. The rear backup camera gives you clear visibility when reversing, while Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain traction and stability. With dual front impact and side impact airbags complemented by overhead airbags, you have comprehensive protection for you and your passengers. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide responsive stopping power when you need it.

Practicality defines the Ridgeline's design. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your hauling needs, whether you're carrying passengers or cargo. SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained on longer drives, while Bluetooth hands-free connectivity lets you stay connected safely. The remote keyless entry and HomeLink garage door transmitter add convenience to everyday use.

This silver Ridgeline represents solid truck ownership—dependable, capable, and ready to serve your needs whether you're heading to the job site or out for the weekend.

description: *Original MSRP $56,335 --- 3.5L EcoBoost, XLT 302A, Twin-Panel Moonroof, Sport Appearance Package, Navigation, Max Trailer Tow & 36-Gallon Fuel Tank!*This *2019 Ford F-150 XLT SuperCrew 4x4* is an exceptionally well-equipped pickup that combines powerful EcoBoost performance, impressive towing capability, and many of the comfort and technology features normally associated with more expensive trim levels. Finished in beautiful *Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat* with a *Black Sport interior*, this F-150 was ordered with the desirable *302A Equipment Group, XLT Sport Appearance Package, twin-panel moonroof, voice-activated navigation, Max Trailer Tow Package, 20-inch wheels, electronic-locking rear axle, and 36-gallon extended-range fuel tank*.*Highlights Include:* * *3.5L EcoBoost V6 --- 375 Horsepower & 470 lb-ft of Torque* * 10-Speed SelectShift Automatic Transmission * *SuperCrew 4x4 --- 157-Inch Wheelbase* * *XLT 302A Equipment Group* * Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat * *XLT Sport Appearance Package* * Black Sport Interior with Front Bucket Seats & Center Console * *Twin-Panel Moonroof* * *Voice-Activated Navigation* * *Max Trailer Tow Package* * *Pro Trailer Backup Assist* * Integrated Trailer Brake Controller * *36-Gallon Extended-Range Fuel Tank* * *3.55 Electronic-Locking Rear Axle* * 7,050-lb GVWR Package * *20-Inch Six-Spoke Painted Aluminum Wheels* * All-Terrain Tires * *XLT Power Equipment Group* * Power-Sliding Rear Window * *Remote Start* * *SYNC 3 with 8-Inch Touchscreen* * Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Capability * *Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking* * Rearview Camera * Reverse Sensing System * Automatic High-Beam Headlights * LED Side-Mirror Spotlights * *Tailgate Step* * LED Bed Lighting * 110V/400W Power Outlet * Rear Window Defroster * SiriusXM Radio Capability * FordPass Connect with 4G Wi-Fi Hotspot Capability * Trailer Sway Control * SecuriCode Keyless Entry KeypadUnder the hood is Ford's highly desirable *3.5L EcoBoost V6*, producing an impressive *375 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque*. Paired with the *10-speed automatic transmission*, this engine delivers strong acceleration and outstanding low-end torque, making it an excellent choice for towing, hauling, highway travel, and everyday driving.This particular F-150 stands out because of its *XLT 302A Equipment Group*, which adds desirable comfort and convenience features including *remote start, SiriusXM radio capability, and a rear-window defroster*. Combined with the other factory options, this truck offers an equipment level well beyond that of a typical XLT.One of its most attractive features is the *twin-panel moonroof*, which stretches across both rows of the SuperCrew cab and gives the interior a bright, open feel. This is a particularly desirable option on an XLT and makes the truck feel more like a premium SUV when traveling with passengers.The *Black Sport interior with front bucket seats and a full center console* provides a comfortable and practical cabin layout. The spacious SuperCrew configuration offers excellent rear-seat legroom, while the 60/40 folding rear bench provides additional flexibility for carrying passengers or cargo inside the cab.The *XLT Sport Appearance Package* gives this truck a distinctive, athletic appearance that complements the premium *Ruby Red Metallic Tinted Clearcoat* exterior. Optional *20-inch six-spoke painted aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires* complete the look and give this F-150 a particularly attractive stance.Technology is another major strength. The *SYNC 3 system with an 8-inch touchscreen* provides convenient access to audio, phone connectivity, and vehicle functions, while the optional *voice-activated navigation system* adds factory route guidance.* Apple CarPlay and Android Auto* compatibility make it easy to connect a compatible smartphone for calls, messages, music, and navigation applications.This truck also includes *FordPass Connect with 4G Wi-Fi hotspot capability*, allowing compatible devices to connect when the appropriate service is activated.For buyers who tow, this F-150 has an especially desirable combination of equipment. The *Max Trailer Tow Package* includes the *36-gallon extended-range fuel tank and integrated trailer brake controller*, while *Pro Trailer Backup Assist* helps simplify the process of backing a trailer. The *3.55 electronic-locking rear axle* provides additional traction when needed, and Trailer Sway Control adds another level of confidence when towing.The *36-gallon fuel tank* is a particularly valuable feature for anyone who travels regularly or pulls a trailer. Compared with a smaller standard fuel tank, it provides greater driving range between fuel stops and makes long-distance travel more convenient.Safety technology includes *Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking*, designed to help detect a potential frontal collision and provide warning and braking assistance when appropriate. The *rearview camera and reverse sensing system* help when backing up or maneuvering in tight spaces, while *automatic high-beam headlights* provide additional convenience during nighttime driving.The *XLT Power Equipment Group* adds several useful features, including a *power-sliding rear window, LED bed lighting, and a 110V/400W power outlet*. The optional *tailgate step* makes climbing into the bed much easier, especially when loading equipment or accessing cargo.Other practical features include *LED side-mirror spotlights, remote start, a SecuriCode keyless-entry keypad, power windows and locks, cruise control, trailer sway control, and a locking removable tailgate*.With its *157-inch wheelbase*, this SuperCrew provides a longer configuration than the more common 145-inch-wheelbase version, making it especially appealing to buyers who want additional pickup-bed utility without sacrificing the comfort of a full four-door cab.If you're looking for an F-150 that combines *strong EcoBoost performance, four-wheel-drive capability, premium appearance, family-friendly comfort, and serious towing equipment*, this *2019 Ford F-150 XLT SuperCrew 4x4* is an excellent choice.With its *3.5L EcoBoost, 302A Equipment Group, twin-panel moonroof, Sport Appearance Package, navigation, Max Trailer Tow Package, Pro Trailer Backup Assist, 20-inch wheels, electronic-locking rear axle, 36-gallon fuel tank, *this is a particularly well-optioned XLT that offers many of the features buyers want most in a full-size pickup.*Don't miss out---call King's Colonial Ford at 877-546-4367 or stop by today for a test drive. We're located at 3565 Community Rd, Brunswick, GA.*
